title: ConfFlow workflow V3 (DRAFT — design only)
description: DRAFT ONLY. Not used by the runtime, not part of any package data, and NOT referenced by workflow_schema_sha256 or the configuration contract. See docs/rfc/WORKFLOW_V3_RFC.md. R3.2 replaces this with a production schema.

extensions.description: Semantic, namespaced producer data. Participates in the definition fingerprint.

annotations.description: Non-semantic presentation data (GUI layout, comments). Never fingerprinted.

id.description: Workflow-local, immutable step identity. Lowercase only.

from_step.description: Id of an upstream calc step whose checkpoint file is reused.

id.description: Required in a runnable definition. Optional in a parseable recipe fragment (allocated on instantiate, RFC §19).

label.description: Human-facing title. May duplicate; never an identity.

type.description: Canonical step type. Legacy aliases task/gen are V2-adapter only.

enabled.description: When false, the step is a pass-through bypass (RFC §12).

inputs.description: Geometry/data-flow predecessors. Empty array = consumes the workflow input (root).

params.description: Step-type-specific parameters; unknown members are preserved and warned.
